sloka: तस्य काञ्चनचित्राङ्गं रथं साश्वं ससारथिम् ।जघान समरे श्रीमानङ्गदो वेगवान् कपिः ।। ६.४३.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: tasya kāñcanacitrāṅgaṁ rathaṁ sāśvaṁ sasārathim ।jaghāna samare śrīmānaṅgado vegavān kapiḥ ।। 6.43.19 ।।।।

translations.english: With the same mace (snatched from the Rakshasa) Angada swiftly struck Indrajit hand destroyed the horse, chariot, and charioteer.
